reviews.title: This review goes to NiceGhost and others.
reviews.text: Hey NiceGhost. I read your review and I don’t like it when you said that this game was a waste of your time. Sure, it may have ads, but no game that includes our Savior in it will be “a waste of time.” Other than that, this game is awesome. I enjoy the questions and it gives me a bit of challenge to test my knowledge in Christ. I hope everyone has a blessed day, and remember, Jesus loves you all. I can’t wait to see many of you who are playing this game in Heaven one day! Trust Christ today!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: The whole reason that I downloaded this game was to see what my knowledge of the Bible was. But this game like so many others you can't advance you can't get to the next level unless you watch ads and some of the ads are just not OK. So I guess I'm gonna have to delete and try to find a different one to download. Also, it would be really nice if I could listen to my Christian music while I'm playing I can listen to my Christian music while I'm playing secular games. Why is it that I can't listen to it when I'm playing Christian games? I'm not watching ads and if I have to watch ads to advance, I'm just gonna delete the game.
